sources.rightsStatus: decompilation reference; no blanket artwork grant identified
mixed GPL scripts, CC-BY-SA originals and Nintendo-derived material; review each file

notes: Content hashes deduplicate bytes, not item identity or custody.

Static inventory icons do not imply thrown, held, overworld or animated move coverage.
